title: Config and agent settings cannot widen a chat upload
No uploader identity means no ingest
Same file from two users is two private copies
Another user of the same agent gets nothing, on any surface
Knowledge routes give a user their own chat files and nobody else's
Admin access to a chat scope is an audited override
A staged chat upload cannot be pulled into knowledge by someone else
Legacy chat files are quarantined, audited, nothing lost
